sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the 2003 Mr. Basketball America and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, passing ability, and basketball IQ. He has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010, 2014–2018), Miami Heat (2010–2014), and Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present). With the Heat, he won two NBA championships (2012, 2013) and earned four consecutive Finals MVP awards. He returned to Cleveland to win the franchise’s first title in 2016, then moved to the Lakers, winning another championship in 2020.

Beyond the court, LeBron is a prolific philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the I PROMISE School, a public school for at‑risk children in Akron. He has also produced films and television shows through his company SpringHill Entertainment, and he has been involved in various business ventures, including a partnership with Nike and a stake in the NBA’s Los Angeles Clippers.

LeBron’s accolades include multiple NBA Most Valuable Player awards, All‑Star selections, and Olympic gold medals with Team USA (2008, 2012, 2016). He is celebrated not only for his on‑court achievements but also for his leadership, community impact, and influence on the cultural conversation around sports and social justice.
